sentences.span: the 10yr (+4.8bps to 4.80%) Treasury yield reached its highest level since October 2023, while 2yr (+5.8bps to 4.40%) reached its highest level since July 2024
sentences.why: DB's Early Morning Reid note reports both figures exactly: 10yr at a post-2023 high of 4.80% and 2yr at 4.40%, highest since July 2024.

sentences.span: higher commodity inflation is now pulling the front end with it as the market prices a greater chance the Fed actually responds
sentences.why: Author byline is 'Rich Privorotsky · Goldman Sachs · Equity Sales / Basics', matching the 'Goldman's equity sales desk' attribution, and the fuel-to-front-end-yields-to-priced-Fed-response mechanism is stated directly.

sentences.span: side-note: Trading as if they were the same asset. if we want relief on rates we first need relief on energy.
sentences.why: Near-verbatim match to the note's side-note under a heating-oil-vs-10yr-yield chart.

sentences.span: If energy keeps rising, the Fed reaction function gets dragged with it and sustained upside becomes much harder.
sentences.why: Direct match, same Goldman equity sales desk author as s2; 'sustained equity upside' is a fair gloss of 'sustained upside' given the surrounding risk-assets context.

sentences.span: if we want relief on rates we first need relief on energy
sentences.why: Rhetorical restatement with no distinct checkable content of its own; the stance it restates (resolution comes from an energy price move, not argument) matches this Goldman note's actual position.

sentences.span: If the administration can get crude, gas and product prices lower, yields can stabilize and risk has a path to recover… provided NFP/CPI cooperate.
sentences.why: Faithful paraphrase of the same conditional (NFP=payrolls, CPI=inflation); 'refined product' and 'come down' don't change the substance.

sentences.span: NFP and CPI are the critical inputs with CPI on Sep 11 the more important of the two prints given Warsh's view that the US is at full employment ad Friday's print is unlikely to drive a material change
sentences.why: Source is J.P. Morgan (the same artifact uses 'J.P.' for JPMorgan in s11, so bare 'Morgan' misattributes this to a different, non-existent-in-corpus bank), and JPM ranks CPI ABOVE payrolls for the Fed meeting -- the opposite of the sentence's claim that payrolls rates above CPI. No TS Lombard file in the corpus mentions payrolls as 'the deciding data point' either.

sentences.span: For SPX index options expiring on September 4, 2026, using data from August 31, show a 1.1% implied move.
sentences.why: Exact match (J.P. Morgan Market Intelligence); the sentence is a faithful, compressed restatement.

sentences.span: Activity across our desk slightly moderated last week, reflecting a natural deceleration ... Looking ahead, we estimate the Q3 blackout window will begin ~9/15, when roughly ~40% of the S&P 500 is estimated to enter their quiet period
sentences.why: Goldman's buyback desk describes volumes as moderating/decelerating (calling the corporate bid 'a cushion'), the reverse of 'near their peak,' and the blackout window is a discrete future start date (~9/15), not something currently 'expanding.'

sentences.span: After the bell, DELL shares are indicated +8.4% higher following strong EPS.
sentences.why: Exact figure and timing match Goldman's US Daily Download note on DELL's post-earnings reaction; the sentence omits the ticker but doesn't misstate figure or direction.

sentences.span: Consensus models Revenue +33%QoQ & +85%YoY, and my buyside survey shows even higher expectations of +36% & +89%
sentences.why: Figures match exactly (33% QoQ, 85% YoY consensus); the trailing 'while J.P.' correctly sets up JPMorgan's own higher buyside-survey figure. Sentence is truncated in the sample but what's present is accurate.

sentences.span: our GS EU Nat Gas Consumers basket is composed of European companies expected to underperform with rising natural gas prices; ticker is GSXETTFX Index and basket includes 51 stocks; on the long side, we highlight our GS EU Power Price Sensitive Utilities basket (GSXEPWPR Index, 16 stocks)
sentences.why: Bank, stock counts (51 short / 16 long), and the higher-power-prices-benefits-utilities logic all match exactly; 'the region' = Europe per the surrounding TTF gas-price context.

sentences.span: the economy expanded 0.4% quarter-on-quarter in Q2, surpassing expectations of 0.3% growth. On an annual basis, GDP rose 2.1%, ahead of the consensus estimate of 1.8% ... the yield on policy-sensitive three-year government bond is currently +7.5bps to 4.79%, as investors increased bets that the RBA's tightening cycle could extend
sentences.why: Every figure matches exactly and the RBA-hike-bets framing is accurate.

sentences.span: keep an eye on gold to see if $4,300 acts as support
sentences.why: The $4,300 support level is real, but the source is J.P. Morgan, not 'Morgan' -- the source corpus consistently self-identifies as 'JP Morgan'/'J.P. Morgan', never bare 'Morgan', and this same artifact uses 'J.P.' for JPMorgan in s11, so unqualified 'Morgan' misattributes the call.

sentences.span: We continue to think this is an opportunity to add again, looking for debasement trade to resume
sentences.why: Both halves of the described split (strategy team buy-the-dip / US desk expecting the debasement trade to struggle until the Sep 16 Fed meeting) trace to J.P. Morgan documents, but the sentence attributes them to 'Morgan' -- misattribution for the same reason as s14.
